create_LookViT_model: create a LookViT model for image classification with lookup-based cross-attention between low-res and high-res tokens
build_LookViT_forward_pass: build a forward pass through LookViT that processes an image tensor and returns classification logits
create_Attention_module: create an Attention module supporting cross-attention, attention reuse, and QK similarity output for bidirectional lookup
create_MLP_block: create an MLP block with bias-less LayerNorm, GELU activation, and dropout for use inside LookViT transformer layers
create_LayerNorm_custom: create a custom bias-less LayerNorm with unit offset trick for stable normalization in transformer architectures
